verdict.rationale: mParticle documents an HTTP Events API for sending event batches directly to its Event Server, backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, so the core server-to-server ingestion path exists. Nothing in the evidence describes how that API authenticates callers or what delivery guarantees it gives (retries, acknowledgements, idempotency). missing for 10: documented authentication scheme for the Events API, delivery guarantees (retry/ack/idempotency semantics), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can send events server-to-server through a documented HTTP ingestion API with authentication and delivery guarantees

citations.quote: Use the Open API (previously known as Swagger) specification or similar tools to generate helper SDKs (using Swagger Codegen or OpenAPI Generator) for the Events API
This is the mParticle Event Server
Every Events API batch carries an environment field
